question: What is Morgan Stanley's strategy to increase their net new assets?

claims.text: On the 4Q24 earnings call (January 2025), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said Morgan Stanley remains "an industry leader in organic growth". Full-year 2024 NNA was $252 billion, about 5% annual growth of beginning period assets. She said the advisor-led channel drove the results, benefiting from both existing clients and new clients coming to the firm.

On the 1Q25 call (April 2025), the CFO cited NNA of $94 billion, a 6% annualized growth rate of beginning period assets. She said the result was supported by broad-based strength across channels: elevated flows from advisor-led clients, stock plan vesting events, positive recruiting trends, and self-directed clients.

On the 2Q25 call (July 2025), the CFO described workplace as a source of NNA. New flows from workplace go into the advisor-led channel and also become fee-based flows. She said 70% of the flows that originate from workplace are net new assets to the firm, and she tied this to the firm's investments in workplace.

On the 3Q25 call (October 2025), the CFO said all channels are strong. In self-directed, the firm has been increasing marketing and business development. In advisory, new and existing clients are coming in, and the firm is attracting assets held away and new clients using tools given to advisors. She called workplace "probably the most exciting part" and said "we're just scratching the surface." Workplace brings assets in as NNA and directly into fee-based flows, including as IPOs come to market. Clients drop assets into self-directed accounts and also move them directly into advisor-led accounts.

On the 4Q25 call (January 2026), CEO Ted Pick said the financial advisor workplace and E*TRADE retail channels are each "thriving". He said the business had NNA of over $350 billion last year and attracted $1.6 trillion plus of NNA over five years, with a doubling of fee-based flows. He said "The funnel is working." Management also said it continues to invest in each business segment through human capital and technology. The CFO cited full-year 2025 NNA of $356 billion and fee-based flows of $160 billion, and said workplace and E*TRADE relationships continue to seek out advice.

Reported 2026 results: Wealth Management added NNA of $118 billion and fee-based flows of $54 billion in 1Q26 (10-Q, May 2026). In 2Q26 (press release, July 2026), NNA were $148 billion, of which just over half were inflows related to IPOs of certain clients in the Workplace channel. In 3Q26 (press release, October 2026), record NNA were $232 billion, with just over half associated with IPO-related flows, and fee-based flows were $80 billion. The firm said the fee-based flows included a new corporate retirement mandate.

In its 2Q26 and 3Q26 press releases, the firm said Wealth Management non-compensation expenses increased from a year ago, driven in part by higher marketing and business development expenses (2Q26 and 3Q26) and technology spend.

The 2Q26 10-Q (August 2026) names factors that influence NNA: client investment and spending behaviors, seasonality, "our ability to attract and retain financial advisors and clients", capital market and corporate activities affecting certain client channels, and large idiosyncratic inflows and outflows, including single large client events. It says that, should these factors continue, the growth rate of NNA may be impacted.

adjacent.text: WealthManagement.com (trade press, 2026-10-14) reported that Morgan Stanley's wealth assets doubled analysts' expectations with a record $232 billion in NNA, a 57% jump quarter-over-quarter and a 187% increase from the prior year.
adjacent.differs_because: Trade-press reporting is indicative, not authoritative. It reports the NNA result and does not describe the firm's strategy.

gaps.what: No single management-stated NNA strategy or target is in the evidence. The strategy above is assembled from management comments on channels (workplace, advisor-led, self-directed), recruiting, marketing and results. The January 2026 strategic update deck is present only as end notes.
gaps.suggested_source: Morgan Stanley January 2026 strategic update presentation (slides 8–9) and the Wealth Management sections of earnings-call prepared remarks
